## Invitations

A total of 1877 invitations were issued during the outreach period. Attendance was 1231, representing a rate of 65.6 per cent. The invitation and attendance figures provide the basis for monitoring participation and reviewing the effectiveness of the outreach activity. Attendance levels will inform future contact arrangements and support continued engagement with invited residents.

## Contact

SMS contact reached 1595 invitees. A reminder was also sent to 1595 invitees to support attendance and maintain awareness of the outreach activity. Contact arrangements were used to provide consistent information and encourage invited residents to attend.

Van days were maintained where roads allowed, supporting outreach delivery in areas accessible by road. These arrangements were kept under review during the reporting period so that contact could continue where local conditions permitted.

Prepared by G. Evans.
